Luca (Support): Escalation: WillowTech onboarding blocked - intermittent 403 on SAML token exchange (aud mismatch). Raised INC-9715. Customer in active onboarding cohort; renewal ~6w. Need CS to lead comms + quick enablement.

Zoe (CS): Thanks Luca. Can you confirm whether failures are only for a subset of IdPs or across both Okta/Azure? Who's the WillowTech POC?

Luca (Support): Fails across Okta + Azure; ~14% of first-run attempts. POC = Priya (priya@willowtech.io). Minimal repro: 1) upload SAML metadata -> 2) POST /tenant/provision -> 3) exchange returns 403 "audience_not_valid". Sample log: "auth: aud mismatch expected 'redwood-svc' got 'redwood-embed'". Traces attached to INC-9715.

Pri (CSM): Marking P0 for CS handoff due to onboarding impact + renewal proximity. Proposed comms plan: 1) Short transparent note to Priya with ETA + mitigation, 2) Offer manual provisioning for priority users, 3) Schedule a 30m walkthrough, 4) Add renewal-watch in CRM. I can draft the email and run provisioning.

Diego (Solutions Eng): I can own triage. Hypothesis: audience header normalization regression from last deploy. Short mitigation: accept legacy aud values behind a feature-flag and log originals. I'll run an aud-enumeration job and aim for a staging canary in ~2h; prod patch after smoke tests.

Zoe (CS): Owners: Diego = SE owner, Pri = CS owner, Luca = Support logs. Pri post the customer email link when sent. Diego ping when canary is up. I'll file renewal note: "Onboarding friction; SE triage; manual provisioning offered; renewal in 6w."
